description: The metrics the daemon gives on /metrics, in the Prometheus text format 0.0.4, in this order. A metric keeps its name, its type and its labels, in this order; one may be added. The Go and the Rust versions give the same text for the same state (conformance/vectors/metrics.json).

metrics.name: atoll_build_info
metrics.help: Always 1: the version Atoll was built as.

metrics.name: atoll_disk_info
metrics.help: Always 1: each disk of the configuration, its filesystem, its role and its mount path.

metrics.name: atoll_disk_state
metrics.help: 1 for the state the disk is in, 0 for each other: online, standby, readonly, draining, missing or failed.

metrics.name: atoll_disk_capacity_bytes
metrics.help: The disk's size, as a mount check last measured it.

metrics.name: atoll_disk_free_bytes
metrics.help: The bytes the disk has free, as a mount check last measured them.

metrics.name: atoll_disk_copies
metrics.help: The copies the catalog holds on the disk, as the last pass left them.

metrics.name: atoll_disk_copy_bytes
metrics.help: The bytes of those copies.

metrics.name: atoll_files
metrics.help: The files in each state, as the last pass left them.

metrics.name: atoll_file_bytes
metrics.help: The bytes of the files in each state, as the last pass left them.

metrics.name: atoll_passes_total
metrics.help: The passes that ended since the daemon started.

metrics.name: atoll_pass_failures_total
metrics.help: The passes that failed since the daemon started.

metrics.name: atoll_last_pass_end_timestamp_seconds
metrics.help: When the last pass ended, in seconds since the epoch.

metrics.name: atoll_last_pass_duration_seconds
metrics.help: How long the last pass took.

metrics.name: atoll_last_pass_partial
metrics.help: 1 when the last pass skipped a disk, or left an operation planned or failed.

metrics.name: atoll_last_pass_held
metrics.help: 1 when a guard held something in the last pass.

metrics.name: atoll_operations_total
metrics.help: The operations of the passes since the daemon started, by kind and outcome.

metrics.name: atoll_copied_bytes_total
metrics.help: The bytes of the replicas the passes made since the daemon started, those of the files on the SSD cache among them.

metrics.name: atoll_files_waiting
metrics.help: The files the last pass left waiting: their settle, their window, or line power.

metrics.name: atoll_disk_smart_failing
metrics.help: 1 when the disk's last reading of SMART says its health check failed.

metrics.name: atoll_disk_smart_sectors
metrics.help: The sectors the disk's last reading of SMART counts: reallocated, pending or uncorrectable.

metrics.name: atoll_disk_temperature_celsius
metrics.help: The temperature of the disk's last reading of SMART.

metrics.name: atoll_disk_smart_read_timestamp_seconds
metrics.help: When SMART was last read on the disk awake, in seconds since the epoch.

metrics.name: atoll_alert
metrics.help: Each condition of an alert that holds, with its count, as the last pass worked them out, whether or not a channel is set.

metrics.name: atoll_ups_power
metrics.help: 1 for what the UPS runs on, 0 for each other: online, battery or low.

metrics.name: atoll_ups_unreachable
metrics.help: 1 when the UPS has said nothing for 15 s or more.

metrics.name: atoll_disk_standby
metrics.help: 1 when the disk's last mount check found it asleep.

metrics.name: atoll_trash_entries
metrics.help: The entries in the disk's trash, as the last pass left them.

metrics.name: atoll_trash_bytes
metrics.help: The bytes in the disk's trash, as the last pass left them.

metrics.name: atoll_scrub_due_copies
metrics.help: The copies the scrub has to read on the disk, as the last pass left them.

metrics.name: atoll_scrub_due_bytes
metrics.help: The bytes of those copies.

metrics.name: atoll_scrub_read_copies_total
metrics.help: The copies the scrub read whole on the disk and found as their hashes say, since the daemon started.

metrics.name: atoll_scrub_read_bytes_total
metrics.help: The bytes of those copies.

metrics.name: atoll_scrub_corrupt_total
metrics.help: The copies the scrub found corrupt on the disk since the daemon started.
